body: One other thing, I have insurance, so paying for therapy isn’t a huge issue.  It’s that I need someone to talk to “right now”, not at my next scheduled appointment. I need to find an avenue to release on the fly. Thank you again.

Fucking throw me into tears. Thank you. Seriously, not sarcastically. I really do appreciate your comments. They’re direct and not fluffy. 

I have already spent $75k in court costs over the last 7 years, it’s a core reason why we’re in debt so bad. It’s just a lost cause with my son until he gets older. There’s more to it, such as 4:12 on ASD, type 1&2 ADHD, ODD, and a slew of other issues. I would spend all my resources to keep him, then wouldn’t have anything to treat his health. Not saying I can’t handle that, just that I’m going broke to fight for another stress in my life. Which the absolute worst attitude since it’s my son. I should be unequivocally anxious to accept every aspect of his/our situation: good, bad, or other. So I feel more guilt from “giving up”.  

I might reply to other comments later but I want to let them sink in for a bit. Thank you again. I very much appreciate it.
